production.description: Edit multi-source videos and create finished cuts in Pireel Studio from your AI agent.
production.shortDescription: Edit videos from your AI agent
production.longDescription: Connect your AI agent to Pireel Studio for local media import, transcript editing, montage and multi-output variants, designed graphics, captions, themes, framing and local export. Every result remains visible and editable in the Studio timeline.

preview.description: Pireel Studio against the preview environment. Testers only; built locally, never published.
preview.shortDescription: Try the latest Pireel agent workflows
preview.longDescription: This preview channel connects to Pireel's isolated preview environment and ships the latest workflow before public release. It supports local media import, transcript editing, montage and multi-output variants, designed graphics, captions, themes, framing and local export. Edits remain visible and editable in Pireel Studio Preview.
